blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Tokenization-free, pixel-based language models (PLMs) have recently been proposed as an alternative to conventional token-based language models (TLMs), typically motivated by practical considerations, e.g., the flexibility to support new languages or vocabularies. Nevertheless, PLMs also have the potential to serve as infrastructure for computational (psycho)linguistics, where tokenization has been a source of bias in estimating information-theoretic values, such as surprisal, and has pushed the bottom-up visual orthographic features outside the scope. In this study, we first integrate PLMs into the modeling of naturalistic human reading and, in particular, examine their use to estimate next-word predictability, which can also integrate orthographic and parafoveal information. Our results demonstrate that next-word prediction difficulty, computed in pixel space, has strong predictive power for gaze duration and word skipping behavior across various languages. In particular, their advantage is complementary to existing token-level surprisal and entropy estimates. Cross-lingual analyses with script variations also clarify their distinctive visual processing biases, facilitating research into how bottom-up visual information is incrementally integrated into expectation-based reading.
blocks.zh: 最近有人提议,不使用类似像素的语言模型(PLMs),作为传统符号语言模型(TLMs)的替代物,典型的动机是实际考虑,例如支持新语言或词汇的灵活性。 尽管如此,PLM也有可能成为计算(psycho)语言学的基础设施,在计算信息理论值时,标注学一直是偏颇的来源,如超平等,并将自下而上的视觉正文特征推出范围外. 在这项研究中,我们首先将PLM纳入自然主义人类阅读的模型化,并特别审查它们用于估算下个字的可预测性,这也能够将正文和抛物资料相融合. 我们的结果显示,用像素空间计算的下个字的预测困难,在视线持续期间具有很强的预测力,并且字词跳过各种语言的行为. 特别是,它们的优势是对现有的象征性水平的超额和等效估计的补充. 具有脚本变化的跨语言分析也澄清了它们独特的视觉处理偏差,有助于研究如何将自下而上的视觉信息逐渐地纳入基于期望的阅读.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Reading coordinates a stratification of low- and high-level cognitive processes Engbert et al. (2005) across multiple modalities Hoover and Gough (1990) .
Naturalistic reading data, for example, indicate that a considerable proportion of words is processed without a fixation; they are possibly recognized in the parafovea Schotter et al. (2012) ; Rayner (1998) with only partial visual information Reichle et al. (2003) .
Such a rapid pre-attentive visual processing suggests the importance of a bottom-up sensory prediction Kok and de Lange (2015) ; Tarkiainen et al. (1999) , especially how graded visual presentation affects reading time and skipping Gordon et al. (2013) via top-down prediction Ding et al. (2025) .

blocks.en:
In computational psycholinguistics, neural language models (LMs) have been ubiquitous in estimating information-theoretic values, such as surprisal Hale (2001) ; Levy (2008) , to instantiate linguistic theories.
Despite their successful interdisciplinary bridge, recent studies have also identified drawbacks of ordinal LMs defined over a fixed set of token IDs (token-based language models; TLMs) as tools for cognitive modeling.
In particular, their tokenizers and vocabularies, predefined regardless of their cognitive plausibility Haslett (2025) , potentially limit feasible experimental designs, e.g., estimating highly incremental probabilities across more fine-grained units, or implicitly bias experimental results Nair and Resnik (2023) ; Oh and Schuler (2024) ; Giulianelli et al. (2024) ; Oh and Schuler (2025) ; Kiegeland et al. (2026) .
For example, Nair and Resnik (2023) reported that a tokenizer or (sub)word definition easily biases the surprisal estimate − log ⁡ p ⁡ ( word | context ) -\log p(\mathrm{word}|\mathrm{context}) .
Another example is that a naive accumulation of subword probabilities results in their misallocation to the following word, e.g., “He give me ”, where the load of “give” can be dislocated to “ me ,” if the alternative “gives” is also split into the common prefix “give” and “s” Oh and Schuler (2024) ; Giulianelli et al. (2024) .
Although some problems have quick solutions, tokenizer selection is inherently the source of biases in computational psycholinguistic experiments with TLMs.
More fundamentally, TLM also limits the possibility of experimental design; for example, the word-to-ID conversion makes it impossible to study the visual and orthographic effects in reading.

blocks.en:
In this paper, to handle such tokenization bottlenecks spread in modern TLM-based cognitive modeling, we examine the use of tokenization-free, pixel-based language models ( PLM s) Borenstein et al. (2023) ; Rust et al. (2023) ; Lotz et al. (2023) in computational psycholinguistics.
PLMs encode text as pixel-based images, potentially without loss of visual fidelity to what humans can indeed see, enabling flexible research designs, for example, to explore how text layout, font, or orthographic complexity drives reading Borenstein et al. (2023) .
This work, as a case study, specifically explores the psychometric predictive power of PLMs and parafoveal effects in reading, positing that early-stage visual processing may already begin before fixating on the exact word, and from an expectation-based reading perspective, visual word identifiability will be a strong predictor of human gaze duration and scan path.
We compute word predictability and entropy with PLMs that rely on orthographic information and a blurred future context, intended to reflect parafoveal sight.
These estimates are used to model reading time and word skipping behavior during naturalistic reading.

blocks.en:
Our experimental results show that the visual word prediction difficulty estimated by PLMs offers complementary predictive power to conventional token-based surprisal.
This advantage is observed across languages, particularly in those with scripts other than the Latin alphabet, demonstrating that PLM is a useful infrastructure for estimating word predictability and modeling human reading across diverse languages.

不同语言都观察到这一优势,特别是在有拉丁字母以外的脚本的语文中,这表明PLM是估算词语可预测性和模拟不同语言的人类阅读的有用基础设施.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Reading Time Modeling with Token-based Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 使用托肯语模式阅读时间建模

blocks.en:
Language models (LMs) have been widely used as tools to implement and quantitatively test (neuro and psycho)linguistic theories Caucheteux et al. (2023) ; Ohams et al. (2026) .
Given that LMs are basically next-word prediction machines, their use is typically relevant to testing an expectation-based account of human sentence processing through estimating information-theoretic measures such as surprisal Hale (2001) ; Levy (2008) ; Hale (2016) . Curiously, a misalignment between human reading measures and LM-estimated predictive measures has been indicated by recent studies Kuribayashi et al. (2021) ; Shain et al. (2024) ; Oh and Schuler (2023) , raising several possible explanations.
A conceptually intuitive implication is that prediction is not a complete representation of human sentence processing Slaats and Martin (2025) , which features structural modularistic underpinnings Coltheart et al. (2001) and thus is not purely probabilistic. But practically, another possibility rests on the biases of the proxies, i.e., LMs, in estimating predictive measures Nguyen and Arehalli (2026) .
Existing studies Nair and Resnik (2023) ; Giulianelli et al. (2024) ; Oh and Schuler (2024) ; Oh and Schuler (2025) , for example, demonstrate that the tokenizer substantially affects LM-based cognitive modeling. Besides, language prediction based on token identity prevents any bottom-up visual and orthographic decoding processes. This study explores a more neutral, realistic design for text encoding in LM-based cognitive modeling, i.e., simply inputting the text image as we read texts with our eyes.
blocks.zh:
语言模型(LM)被广泛用作实施和定量测试(神经和心理)语言学理论Caucheteux等人(2023年);Ohams等人(2026年)的工具.
鉴于LMs基本上是下个字的预测机器,其使用通常与通过估计信息理论措施,如Suprisal Hale(2001年);Levy(2008年);Hale(2016年),测试基于期望的人类句子处理情况有关。 奇怪的是,最近的一些研究(Kuribayashi等人(2021年)、Shain等人(2024年)、Oh和Schuler(2023年)都指出了人类阅读测量和LM估计预测测量之间的误差,提出了几种可能的解释。
一个概念上的直观含义是预测并不是人类句子处理Slaats和Martin(2025年)的完整表现,它具有结构模块化基础Coltheart等人(2001年),因此并不纯粹是概率论. 但实际上,另一种可能性在于代理人(即LM)在估计Nguyen和Arehalli(2026年)的预测措施时的偏颇。
例如,现有的研究Nair和Resnik(2023年);Giulianelli等人(2024年);Oh和Schuler(2024年);Oh和Schuler(2025年)表明,标致剂对基于LM的认知模型产生了重大影响。 此外,基于符号身份的语言预测可以防止任何自下而上的视觉和正文解码过程. 本研究探索在基于LM的认知模型中文本编码更中性,更现实的设计,即在我们用眼睛阅读文本时输入文本图像.

blocks.en: 2.2 Pixel-Based Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 基于像素的语言模型

blocks.en:
Fortunately, there are practical techniques for processing language using text images as input.
Pixel-based language model ( PLM ) Rust et al. (2023) , using a visual Transformer (ViT) as its backbone, is a representative model that seamlessly models language in a tokenizer-free paradigm, regardless of vocabulary and character-inventory constraints Lotz et al. (2023) .
Such PLM s have been adopted, for example, to enable a flexible addition of a new language or to process low-resource languages, such as historical languages without transcriptions Borenstein et al. (2023) .
Beneath their powerful performance in the visual domain, probing analyses indicate that PLMs also learn linguistic knowledge, such as semantics and syntax Tatariya et al. (2024) and exhibit cross-script generalizability through multilingual pre-training Kesen et al. (2025) .
In contrast to these studies, we examine the use of PLMs for cognitive modeling.
blocks.zh:
幸运的是,有实用的技术可以使用文本图像作为输入处理语言.
基于像素的语言模型(PLM) Rust et al. (2023),使用视觉变形器(ViT)作为它的骨干,是一种代表性的模型,在无标致器的范式中无缝的模型语言,无论词汇和字符目录限制Loz et al. (2023).
例如,采用这种PLMs是为了能够灵活地增加一种新语言或处理低资源语言,例如没有抄本的历史语言Borenstein等人(2023年)。
俯瞰他们在视觉领域的强大性能,探究分析表明PLMs也学习语言知识,如语义学和语法鞑靼亚等人(2024年),并通过多语种预训Kesen等人(2025年)展现了跨字符通用性.
与这些研究相比,我们研究了PLM用于认知模型的应用.

blocks.en: 3.2 Visual Word Prediction Difficulty (VWPD) in Context
blocks.zh: 3.2 上下文中的视觉文字预测难度(VWPD)

blocks.en: 4.2 Human Reading Data
blocks.zh: 4.2 人类阅读数据

blocks.en:
We model reading time and word skipping behavior of a total of 459 subjects from different eye-movement-while-reading corpora, covering German (Deu), English (Eng), Spanish (Esp), Farsi (Far), Korean (Kor), Simplified Chinese (Simp), Traditional Chinese (Trad), and Turkish (Tur). Data are from MECO Wave 1 Siegelman et al. (2022) or Wave 2 Siegelman et al. (2025) , except for Persian reading corpus Tekbudak et al. (2024) . Data statistics and details are presented in Table 1 .
We take the following reading measures into consideration: First Fixation Duration (FFD), First-pass Reading Time (FPT), Total Reading Time (TRT), First-pass Skipping (FSKP), and Overall Skipping (SKP). For durative measures, any zero fixation duration and zero reading time are excluded.
We adopt two word skipping measures: (i) first-pass skipping — whether an interest area is skipped before a later interest area is fixated (1=yes, 0=no); and (ii) Overall skipping — whether an interest area is not fixated throughout the current trial (1=yes, 0=no).
blocks.zh:

我们考虑下列阅读措施:第一固定时间(FFD)、第一通过阅读时间(FPT)、总阅读时间(TRT)、第一通过跳跃(FSKP)和总体跳跃(SKP)。 就持久性措施而言,任何零固定期限和零阅读时间均不包括在内。
我们通过两个字跳过措施:(一) 第一次通过跳过——是否在以后的某个利益区被固定之前跳过一个利益区(1=是,0=否);和(二) 总体跳过——一个利益区是否在整个审判期间没有固定(1=是,0=否)。

blocks.en: 4.4 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.4 评价计量

blocks.en:
Following existing studies Goodkind and Bicknell (2018) , we use the difference in loglikelihood between two nested models with and without the predictor of interest 𝚡 𝚗 \mathtt{x_{n}} from TLMs or PLMs.
In our case, the joint contribution of the predictor and its subject-specific random slope is measured.
We refer to this metric as psychometric predictive power (PPP).
To test robustness, we rerun each formula 100 times using a crossed random-effects bootstrap with replacement to obtain a distribution of the log-likelihood difference.
Similarly to Goodkind and Bicknell (2018) , we fit regression models to explain the data of interest, but in Appendix 15 , we also adopt 10-fold cross-validation, as in ( Wilcox et al., 2023 ) , yielding consistent results.
When reporting a single PPP value for each language with several datasets (Table 1 ), PPPs for different datasets in the target language are averaged.
blocks.zh:
根据现有的研究 Goodkind 和 Bicknell (2018年), 我们使用两个嵌入式模型之间的对数相似度差异 。
就我们而言,衡量预测器及其特定主题随机坡度的共同贡献。
我们把这个度量法称为心理预测力(PPP).
为了测试稳健性,我们每一次重运行一次,使用一个跨随机效应的靴子套换来得到一个对数相差的分布.
与Goodkind和Bicknell(2018年)相似,我们适合回归模型来解释感兴趣的数据,但在附录15中,我们也采用了10倍的交叉验证,如(Wilcox等人,2023年),得出一致的结果.
在报告每种语言具有若干数据集的单一购买力平价(表1)时,平均使用目标语言的不同数据集的购买力平价。

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 5 实验结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Preliminary Experiments: Comparing Two VWPD Measures
blocks.zh: 5.1 初步试验:比较两项VWPD措施

blocks.en:
In Section 3.2 , we introduced
MSE and SSIM as an image reconstruction error in Eq. 8 .
As preliminary experiments, we compare MSE-based and SSIM-based image reconstruction errors as general indicators of next-word prediction difficulty.
Figure 4 shows that different PPPs are obtained with different error formulations, and there was a clear empirical trend that SSIM is slightly better or comparable to MSE, except for the Chinese (Simplified and Traditional) language.
This might reflect a special visual processing of logograms or the complexity of Chinese characters.
In our main experiments, we show SSIM results across all languages, except for MSE for the Chinese (Simplified and Traditional) data.
Full SSIM and MSE comparison is shown in Appendix E .
blocks.zh:
在3.2节中,我们介绍了
MSE和SSIM作为Eq. 8中的图像重建错误.
作为初步实验,我们比较了基于MSE和SSIM的图像重建错误,作为下一字预测难度的一般指标.
图4显示,不同的购买力平价是用不同的误差配方获得的,除了中文(简化和传统)语言外,有明显的实证趋势认为SSIM略好或与MSE相比.
这可能反映了对日志的特殊视觉处理或中文字符的复杂性.
在我们的主要实验中,我们在所有语言中显示SSIM结果,除了MSE用于中文(简化和传统)数据.
完整的SSIM和MSE比较见附录E。

blocks.en: 5.2 Comparing PLMs and TLMs
blocks.zh: 5.2 比较PLM和TLM

blocks.en: We evaluate two versions of PLMs with and without blurring for the future context, and three TLMs (monolingual GPT2, BERT, and mGPT).
blocks.zh: 我们评估两个版本的PLM, 以及三个TLM(Monolanguage GPT2、BERT和mGPT)。

blocks.en:
Figure 5 shows the results for FFD, FPT, and TRT modeling.
Visual word predictability (VWPD) is used for PLMs, and surprisal is used for TLMs.
PPPs for PLMs are somewhat worse than TLMs, but when these two predictors are jointly used, the PPP substantially increases, indicating their complementary advantage in reading time modeling.
blocks.zh:
图5显示了FFD、FPT和TRT建模的结果。
视觉的单词可预测性(VWPD)用于PLM,而超导用于TLM.
PLM的购买力平价比TLM略差,但如果这两个预测器共同使用,购买力平价就会大幅增加,表明它们在读取时间模型方面的互补优势.

blocks.en:
Figure 6 shows the results for FSKP and SKP; whether the word is skipped or not during reading is predicted.
In contrast to gaze duration measures, PLMs yield comparable or better predictive power, especially for the Farsi (Far), Korean (Kor), and Chinese (Simp and Trad) languages; interestingly, these languages do not adopt the Latin alphabet.
In these languages, in other words, if a word can easily be predicted visually from the surrounding context, it is likely to be skipped during reading.
This idea is also compatible with entropy measures (how the next word is uncertain), and Figure 7 shows the comparison of entropy computed by PLMs and TLMs.
The results generally reproduce our observations with surprisal, i.e., token-level and visual entropy are complementary.
We report the cross-validation analysis in appendix 15 , which substantiates the tendencies we have pointed out above.
blocks.zh:
图6显示FSKP和SKP的结果;阅读时是否跳过此单词是预测的.
相对于视长度测量,PLMs产生可比或更好的预测力,特别是波斯语(Far),朝鲜语(Kor),和汉语(Simp和Trad)语言;有趣的是,这些语言不采用拉丁字母.
换句话说,在这些语言中,如果一个单词可以从周围上下文中轻松地直观地预测出来,它很可能在阅读过程中被跳过.
这个想法也与 en度量法(下个词如何不确定)兼容,图7显示了由PLMs和TLMs计算的 en度量的比较.
其结果一般是用副作用复制我们的观测结果,即象征水平和视觉的 en是互补的.
我们在附录15中报告交叉验证分析,这证实了我们上文指出的趋势。

blocks.en: 5.3 Comparing Addition and Interaction
blocks.zh: 5.3 比较增加和相互作用

blocks.en:
Comparing the PPP of the additive model ( pixel ​ _ ​ uni + gpt \mathrm{pixel\_uni\\
+gpt} ) and the interactive model ( pixel ​ _ ​ uni ∗ gpt \mathrm{pixel\_uni*gpt} ), we sometimes observe an advantage of the interaction term, especially in the first-pass measures (FFD and FSKP) in German (Deu), Spanish (Esp), and Turkish (Tur).
These have somewhat longer word length and richer morphology than those of other languages Siegelman et al. (2022) .
Thus, a strong interaction may imply a more general hierarchical engagement of prediction in reading, spanning from shallow visual perception to morphological or richer linguistic processing.
In the following section, we look into how this interaction shapes first-pass reading behavior.
The detailed breakdown of our main results into individual dataset is in Figures 13 and 14 .
blocks.zh:
比较添加剂模型的PP( 像素 _ uni + gpt\ mathrm{pixel\\\\\\\\\ )
+gpt})和交互模型(像素_uni * gpt\mathrm{pixel\_uni*gpt}),我们有时会观察到交互词的优势,特别是在德语(Deu),西班牙语(Esp)和土耳其语(Tur)的第一通道度量衡(FFD和FSKP)中.
与其他语言Siegelman等人(2022年)相比,这些语言的词长略长,形态较为丰富.
因此,强烈的相互作用可能意味着在阅读中更普遍地进行分级的预测,从浅浅的视觉感知到形态学或更丰富的语言处理.
在下面的一节中,我们研究这种相互作用是如何形成先行读取行为的.
将我们的主要结果详细细分为单个数据集见图13和图14。

blocks.en: 6 Analysis: Characteristics of VWPD
blocks.zh: 6 分析:VWPD的特点

blocks.en: 6.1 Interaction with TLM Surprisal
blocks.zh: 6.1 与TLM Surprisal的相互作用

blocks.en:
Given the complementary advantage of predictors from PLM and TLM, we exploratorily extend the analysis, specifically on how PLM and TLM predictors interact. We focus on early-stage reading measures, such as first fixation duration (FFD), which typically aligns with early lexical access Kurnik (2016) , first-pass reading time (FPT), as well as first-pass refixation duration (FPT minus FFD; FPREF), which indicates the “failure to achieve lexical access” Lowell and Morris (2014) . For simplicity, we only consider the fixed effect of PLM surprisal (namely VWPD) and TLM surprisal (we use GPT2 surprisal in each language).
We split the data into those with relatively high surprisal (+1 SD) and low surprisal ( − - 1 SD) and analyze how the VWPD effect differs between the two subsets.
blocks.zh:
鉴于PLM和TLM的预测器具有互补的优势,我们探索扩大分析范围,尤其是关于PLM和TLM预测器如何相互作用的分析。 我们侧重于早期的阅读措施,例如第一次固定时间(FFD),通常与早期的语法访问Kurnik(2016年),第一次通过阅读时间(FPT),以及第一次通过重修时间(FPT减FFD;FPREF),这表明“未能实现语法访问”Lowell和Morris(2014). 为了简单起见,我们只考虑PLM superprisal(即VWPD)和TLM superprisal(我们在每个语言中使用GPT2 superprisal)的固定效果.
我们把数据分成相对高的超额(+1 SD)和低超额(− - 1 SD)的数据,分析两个子集之间的VWPD效应如何不同.

blocks.en:
Figure 8 shows the interaction between VWPD and GPT2 surprisal.
Interestingly, for FFD, we found that high surprisal (+1 SD in the figure) can reverse (e.g., in Deu and Tur) the VWPD–FFD relationship to be negative.
In contrast to FFD, FPREF results indicate a positive mediation of VWPD, as high surprisal (+1SD in the figure) leads to a positive VWPD-FPREF relationship.
That is, words with a high surprisal (lexical difficulty) tend to weaken the VWPD effect for first fixation but strengthen it for refixation.
One possible interpretation of the neutralized or negative interaction between VWPD and surprisal in FFD prediction is that lexical prediction (token-level surprisal) may involve pre-activation of visual representations Buggy et al. (2026) ; if more effort is devoted to predicting the next word, early-stage visual processing can be skipped.
The positive interaction in FPREF aligns with the finding that orthographic confusion is significant only for unpredictable words Yao et al. (2022) , as the positive interaction was only observed when people need multiple fixations (FPREF), potentially when lexical access initially failed.
blocks.zh:
图8显示了VWPD和GPT2型超导之间的相互作用.
有趣的是,对于FFD来说,我们发现高超(图中的+1 SD)可以逆转(例如在Deu和Tur)VWPD-FFD的关系为负.
与FFD相比,FPREF的结果表明VWPD的积极调解,因为高额的追加(图中为+1SD)会导致VWPD-FPREF的正面关系.
也就是说,具有高超度(英语:lexical different)的词往往会削弱VWPD对第一次固定的效果,但会强化它来进行重整.
对FFD预测中VWPD和超导之间中和或负相互作用的一种可能的解释是,语法预测(token-level suprisal)可能涉及视觉表现的预激活(Buggy et al. (2026));如果更加努力预测下一个单词,早期的视觉处理可以跳过.
FPREF中的积极互动与以下结论一致,即对无法预测的词姚等人(2022年)而言,正交感很严重,因为正交感只有在人们需要多重固定(FPREF)时才被观察到,有可能在词典访问最初失败时被观察到.

blocks.zh: 图8:VWPD与GPT2型超导(+1 SD=高,−−−1 SD=低)到FFD,FPT,和FPREF的相互作用.

blocks.zh: 图9:单向高斯模糊的影响。 积分通过靴子夹获得,蓝色(左)则来自像素设定而不模糊,而红色(右)则来自像素_uni one并模糊. Y轴为PPP.

blocks.en: 6.2 Gaussian Blurring Effects
blocks.zh: 6.2 高斯模糊效应

blocks.en:
We also analyze how Gaussian blurring of the future context affects PPP.
The improvement in predictive power (See Figure 9 ) with the blurring treatment is not substantial.
Still, the advantage is slightly pronounced for SKP in Farsi (Far), Korean (Kor), and Traditional Chinese (Trad), where non-Latin alphabets are used.
The advantage of blurring in Trad has also been suggested by the finding that reading Traditional Chinese characters narrows the perceptual span Pan and Yan (2024) , supporting an information-processing account of visual perception during reading, as assumed in the OB1-Reader model Snell et al. (2018) .
Nevertheless, our Gaussian Blurring is our tentative implementation, and more cognitively motivated designs should be explored in future studies.
blocks.zh:
我们还分析了高斯人对未来背景的模糊性如何影响公私伙伴关系。
预测力的改善(见图9)与模糊的治疗方法相比并不显著。
尽管如此,SKP在波斯语(Far),韩语(Kor)和传统汉语(Trad)中略显优势,使用非拉丁字母.
在Trad中模糊的优点也因以下发现而得到暗示: 阅读传统汉字缩小了感知的跨度Pan和Yan(2024),支持了OB1-Reader模型Snell等人(2018)中假设的阅读过程中视觉感知的信息处理叙述.
尽管如此,我们的高斯布卢林是我们暂时的落实,在未来的研究中应该探索更多的认知动力设计.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We demonstrate that pixel-based LMs can estimate expectation-based visual word-processing measures that complement those estimated by token-based LMs, which are especially relevant to pre-fixation processing on partial input.
This study is the first to introduce a pixel-based language model into computational cognitive modeling. The results demonstrate, at least partial cognitive plausibility of PLM, especially its alignment with early-stage language processing, such as first-pass skipping.
blocks.zh:
我们证明,基于像素的LMs可以估计基于期望的视觉文字处理措施,以补充基于符号的LMs估计的措施,这些措施与部分输入的前置处理特别相关.
本研究是第一个在计算认知模型中引入以像素为基础的语言模型的研究. 结果显示,PLM至少具有部分的认知可信度,尤其是它与早期语言处理的配合,如第一通道跳过.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
First, a pixel-based language model has various rendering strategies Lotz et al. (2023) . We only use the most cross-lingually generalizable setting, namely bigram rendering, which is the foundation of the only multilingual pixel-based model so far. We agree that calculating visual word prediction metrics is highly sensitive to the text rendering strategy. We encourage future work to explore different rendering strategies and analyze their effect on the cognitive plausibility of pixel-based language modeling.
Second, for pixel blurring, we have not conducted an intensive hyperparameter analysis regarding the effects of kernel size and sigma on model performance. We also only tried Gaussian Blurring, without exploring other image corruption methods such as Gaussian Noise. Future work could also compare more cognitively motivated parafoveal blurring and noise. Besides, the human parafovea exhibits graded visual acuity, which is not accounted for in this study. We hope that the current study initiates the primary work and establishes the foundational settings, and that future work will continue to explore parafoveal vision modeling by manipulating the gradedness of visual acuity.
blocks.zh:
首先,基于像素的语言模型有各种渲染策略Loz et al. (2023). 我们只使用最跨语言的泛泛的设定,即bigram渲染,这是迄今为止唯一多语种像素模型的基础. 我们同意,计算视觉文字预测指标对文本渲染策略高度敏感。 我们鼓励今后的工作探索不同的渲染策略,并分析这些策略对以像素为基础的语言模型的认知可信度的影响.
第二,对于像素模糊,我们没有就内核大小和西格玛对模型性能的影响进行密集的超参数分析。 我们还只尝试过高斯布卢林,而没有探索其他的形象腐败方法,如高斯噪音. 未来的工作还可以比较更多认知动机的抛物线模糊和噪音. 此外,人类抛物物物展品还分级视觉敏锐度,本研究对此没有说明. 我们希望目前的研究能够启动初级工作,建立基础环境,希望今后的工作能够通过操纵视觉敏锐度的分级,继续探索抛物视觉模型.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: This study uses open-source eye-movement-while-reading data collected from IRB-approved studies. No personally identifiable information is used in our experiment. Our study aims to gain knowledge about human cognition. We do not curate any system to replace humans in terms of reading.
blocks.zh: 本研究使用从IRB批准的研究中收集的开源眼动读数据. 我们的实验中没有使用个人识别信息。 我们的研究旨在获得有关人类认知的知识. 在阅读方面,我们不管理任何替代人类的制度。

blocks.en: AI Writing/Coding Assistance Policy
blocks.zh: AI 撰写/编码援助政策

blocks.en:
AI writing assistance systems like Grammarly and ChatGPT are occasionally used to correct grammatical and spelling errors and to adjust phrasing.
Our use of writing assistants complies with the AI writing assistance policy described in ARR guidelines under category (a), assistance purely with the language of the paper.
blocks.zh:
AI的写作协助系统,如Grammarly和ChatGPT,偶尔也用于纠正语法和拼写错误,并调整措辞.
我们使用书写助理,符合ARR准则(a)类中描述的AI书写协助政策,即纯粹用论文的语言提供援助。

blocks.en: To adapt Persian to the bigram renderer, we leave the space between two characters, even if they are connected visually. However, the space does not change the pre-space word into an unconnected form if it is originally in a connected form. To gather VWPD from Persian, we did not include the white-area. For the results in the current paper, we used the checkpoint after the 33,500th step results of the PSR dataset.
blocks.zh: 为了使波斯语适应大ram渲染器,我们留下两个字符之间的空间,即使它们被视觉连接. 然而,空间如果最初是连接的形式,则不会将空间前的单词更改为未连接的形式. 为了从波斯收集VWPD,我们不包括白区. 对于本文中的结果,我们在PSR数据集第33500步结果后使用了检查站.

blocks.en: Compared with blurring, the effect of masking is more nuanced across languages. We notice an advantage of whole-word masking in word skipping in Traditional Chinese, but a disadvantage in Korean. This potentially indicates a language-dependent sub-word processing strategy during naturalistic reading.
blocks.zh: 与模糊化相比,遮掩的效果在语言上更为细微. 我们注意到在传统汉语中用全字遮掩字的优点,但在朝鲜语中是一种缺点. 这有可能表明自然主义阅读过程中一个依赖语言的子词处理策略.

blocks.en: The cross-validation results do not contradict the observation that the MECO Chinese data show a stronger advantage of MSE-based VWPD. A revisit of the 10-fold cross-validation result supports the identical tendencies we have captured in Section 5 . In the first place, an integration, especially an interaction, between token and visual prediction improves reading-time and skipping modeling. Besides, visual prediction accounts for skipping better than token prediction in certain scripts, notably Persian (Far), Korean, and Chinese scripts.
blocks.zh: 交叉验证结果与MECO中文数据显示基于MSE的VWPD更强优势的观点并不矛盾. 重新审视10倍的交叉验证结果,支持我们在第5节中所抓住的相同趋势。 首先,信使和视觉预测的结合,特别是互动,可以改善阅读时间和跳过模型. 此外,视觉预测还说明在某些剧本中跳过比象征性预测更好,尤其是波斯语(Far),韩语,汉语剧本.
